text: Phone face down. Door shut. One hour, locked in.
You can't build anything in 12-second pieces.
Getting bored is part of the work. Stay in the chair.
Do the hard task first. Everything else is a hiding spot.
Make the first ugly version. Fixing is easier than starting.
Your screen time report is a confession. Put the damn phone down.
The algorithm is feasting on your hours. Fuck that. Take them back.
Twelve tabs, three apps, zero progress. Close all that shit.
Color-coding your to-do list for an hour? Hell nah. Do item one.
The group chat will survive an hour without you. Lock the fuck in.
Phone down. Tomorrow starts tonight.
Before you unlock your phone, name what you're unlocking it for.
Phone in your bag, bag across the room. Make checking it a hike.
Finals week: study the stuff you hope isn't on the test.
"One more video" has never once meant one.
Random thought mid-task? Dump it in the notes app. Back to work.
Studying with a show on in the background is just watching a show.
Headphones on doesn't count if you're skipping songs every two minutes.
Read that page again. Your eyes moved, but nothing went in.
Do Not Disturb isn't rude. It's how anything gets built.
Studying with friends turned into hanging out with friends. Pick one.
Downloading another study app is the most fun way to not study.
Three hours of "research" and zero words written. Start writing.
Sit in the front row. It's hard to scroll with the professor right there.
Cramming the night before feels like studying. Spread it across the week.
Finish your part of the group project first. Be the one nobody chases.
Done for the night? Write down exactly where to pick up tomorrow.
Every time you switch tasks, you pay a restart fee. Stop paying it.
Write your three tasks on paper. Paper doesn't send notifications.
Take a walk without headphones. Let your brain finish a thought.
Picked up your phone to set a timer. Still no timer.
Set a screen time limit. Then stop tapping "ignore for today."
Use a website blocker. Willpower is good. A lock is better.
Your browser's homepage shouldn't be a feed. Change it to a blank page.
Grayscale your screen for a week. Watch how boring the feed gets.
Read ten pages of a real book. Notice how long ten pages feels.
Skimming past the confusing part means meeting it again on the exam.
Count the hours you actually focused, not the hours you sat there.
Answer texts in batches, not every time your phone lights up.
Tell someone your deadline out loud. Now you have to hit it.
You don't need motivation to open the file. Just open the file.
A lecture at 2x speed while scrolling isn't learning twice as fast.
Finished a problem? Start the next one before you reach for your phone.
The good ideas show up around minute forty. Don't leave at minute twelve.
Library, back corner, no charger. Work until the battery quits.
Office hours exist. Go to one before the exam, not after.
Waiting room, bus stop, checkout line. Not every gap needs a screen.
What did you finish today? Not start. Finish.
Explain the chapter to your roommate. Wherever you stall, study that.
Turn off autoplay. Make every next video a decision.
Phone off the table at dinner. Hear a whole story without checking anything.
Start each session by writing what "done" looks like.
Due at 11:59 doesn't mean start at 11:15.
Put focus time on your calendar like a lecture you can't skip.
You've been "almost done" for three days. Find the last step.
Clear the desk first. A guitar within reach is a forty-minute break.
Unlocked your phone 60 times before noon? Nothing's that fucking interesting.
Your phone isn't a stress ball. Stop grabbing that shit every time it's hard.
Exam's Thursday. You're watching someone pressure-wash a driveway. Shit, really?
It's 1am and strangers are ranking fast food for you. Hell no. Sleep.
Your focus is out of shape. Hell, everyone's is. Start with 20-minute sets.
Watched a productivity video about not watching videos? Fuck. Close it.
A buzz isn't an emergency. Finish the damn paragraph.
Deep in a stranger's Reddit drama? Get your ass back to chapter four.
Six hours of daily scrolling is a part-time job paying jack shit.
That bookmark's been on page 40 since February. Damn, move it.
Phone's in the drawer but your watch keeps buzzing? Silence that shit too.
Half your feed teaches you nothing. Unfollow the hell out of it.
You posted your study setup an hour ago. Did you study? Hell no.
Checking the feed before you've sat up? Give your brain a damn minute.
Task too big to start? Chop it smaller until starting is easy as hell.
You know what your cousin ate for lunch, but not chapter three? Fuck.
Your phone didn't buzz. You imagined it. Damn, put it away.
Refreshing the news every hour won't change a damn thing. Read once, then work.
Full-screen the doc so nothing else fits. Keep your ass in it.
Ten hours watching tutorials, zero hours building. Flip that shit.
Checking your phone during a movie you picked? Hell, watch the whole thing.
Ten minutes in and you're suddenly checking the weather? Sit your ass down.
Lost forty minutes to "one quick look"? Happens. Restart the damn timer.
Twenty minutes on the toilet scrolling? Your legs went numb for this shit?
Your five-minute break just hit the one-hour mark. Damn, back to it.
Your phone interrupts you more than any person would dare. Shut that shit off.
Your phone's at 100% and your project's at 3%. Damn, charge the other one.
The laundry suddenly feels urgent when the essay's due. Funny how that shit works.
Your 45-minute leg day took two hours because of your phone. Damn.
Open app, close app, open app again. What the hell are you looking for?
Mind wandered off? Normal. Drag its ass back to the page.
Deadline's at midnight and you're picking a font? Fuck the font.
The feed never ends. Your essay does. Get your ass there.
"I'll do it tonight" was last night's plan too. Start the fucking thing.
Texting at a red light? Fuck no. Nothing in there is worth it.
Unplug the router for an hour. Annoying as hell. That's the point.
Sleeping next to your phone "for the alarm"? Buy a damn alarm clock.
The final's tomorrow and you just opened the syllabus? Shit. Start anyway.
Studying in bed always ends the same way. Get your ass to a desk.
Taking breaks isn't slacking. Get your ass up, walk, then lock back in.
Your ass is in the lecture hall. Is your brain?
That daily login reward in your game can wait. Do the damn assignment.
Highlighting the whole book isn't studying, it's fucking coloring. Quiz yourself.
Essay's written but the citations aren't? Finish the fucking citations.
Read the full assignment before you start. Saves your ass later.
